subtitle: Plan your journey across the network.
searchPlaceholder: Station, code, or X Y Z coordinates
searchHint: Search names in any language, station codes, or coordinates.
readyBody: Choose two stations using search or the map.
noRoute: No route is available with these options.
copyFailed: Select and copy the text below.
sameStation: You are already at your destination.
mapHint: Tap a station to set the active field. Tap the departure/destination button to switch. Drag to pan; pinch or scroll to zoom.
mapEditorHint: Select a line to drag its bends. Use Add bend, or Shift + click a line. Drag stations; drag labels to choose one of eight directions. Right-click a bend to remove it. Pinch to zoom with two fingers.
loadError: This network could not be loaded. Check your connection or choose a cached system.
fareNote: Adult single fares use the official origin–destination table. Outside-station transfers assume entry within 20 minutes.
fareBreakNote: The estimated outside-station transfer exceeds 20 minutes; separate journey fares apply.
editorTitle: Build the network. Shape the map.
editorSubtitle: Edit locally, preview immediately, and export one portable JSON file.
deleteConfirm: Delete this item and all connections that reference it?
transferSlope: Additional seconds per transfer familiarity level
conditionsHint: Optional timing variants use declarative option values. Edit them as JSON below.
nothingSelected: Choose an item to edit, or select a station on the map.
duplicateId: This identifier is already in use or is invalid.
editorLocal: Open and edit a local JSON file, then download your changes. This does not change the website’s default maps.
invalidNetwork: Fix validation errors before exporting or previewing.
UNKNOWN_STATION: Select valid departure and destination stations.
footer: FTMC Route Planner v2 · Calculated on your device
unsavedChanges: Your edits have not been downloaded as JSON. Switch networks and discard them? Cancel to keep editing.
historyLoadWarning: The network is valid, but its edit history is damaged. OK: load the network, discard the damaged group and all earlier groups (plus any later groups that cannot be safely replayed). {discarded} groups will be lost; {retained} validated groups will remain. Cancel: reject the entire JSON and keep your current network and history.
historyLoadRejected: JSON was not loaded. Your current network and history were kept.
historyLoadRecovered: Network loaded. Discarded {discarded} history groups; retained {retained} validated groups.
historyEditRecovered: Edit saved. Unusable earlier history was discarded and the redo branch was replaced.
clearHistoryConfirm: Clear all undo and redo history? Your current network will be kept. This cannot be undone.
historyError: Invalid edit history: the operation was not applied.
invalidDraft: Some pending edits are invalid. Fix them or cancel pending edits before continuing.
countTransfer: Count cart changes within the same line
clickPoint: Click a line to place a bend
pointsHint: Select a connection to show its bends. Drag circles to move them; right-click or Delete to remove. Arrow keys move the focused bend.
defaultsHint: Suggestions follow nearby sections and common direction codes on the same line. Distance uses game XYZ coordinates; missing coordinates and transfers use 0. Manual edits turn off automatic suggestions.
fileReadError: Unable to read this JSON file.
